content: आत्मनीन {%a.%} [आत्मने हितः ख] .²1 Belonging to oneself, oneʼs own; कस्यैष आत्मनीनः <ls>M. 4</ls> on whose side is he? .²2 Beneficial to oneself; आत्मनीनमुपतिष्ठते <ls>Ki. 13. 69</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">3. 16</ls>; तमात्मनीनामुदवोढ रामः <ls>Bh. 3. 77</ls>; good, fit, suitable, appropriate (as diet <ab>&c.</ab>); आत्मनीनतया श्रीमान् शिवः श्रीभिः समार्धयत् <ls>Śiva B. 23. 57</ls>. .²3 Existent, sentient. .{@-नः@} .²1 A son. .²2 A wifeʼs brother. .²3 A jester (in dramas).
